project.title: Airbnb Aircover Miniature Motion Campaign
project.medium: product protection campaign film and still system
project.format: miniature world plus CG character campaign

why: A strong reference for product reassurance that avoids dry UI explanation: handcrafted miniature spaces, CG characters, and scenario-based storytelling make an abstract service benefit feel tangible.

compositions.title: Service feature as small world
compositions.study: Aircover is visualized through memorable miniature stay scenarios rather than literal feature diagrams.
compositions.reuse: Use when a service promise needs emotional clarity and scenario proof.

compositions.title: Scenario set as campaign asset library
compositions.study: Different houses, characters, and landscapes create many campaign moments inside one art direction.
compositions.reuse: Build a modular world with repeatable props, framing rules, and character scale.

assets.notes: The miniature treatment makes protection feel warm, specific, and memorable.
assets.reuse: Translate abstract benefits into original scenes with clear stakes and a visible moment of relief.

assets.notes: Short scenes can become social cuts, landing modules, or campaign stills.
assets.reuse: Plan each scene to work as both a loop and a still frame.

motion.title: Lived-in miniature scene
motion.notes: Small character actions communicate story, scale, and service promise quickly.
motion.fallback: Use a still frame with one readable action and a protected focal point.

implementation.notes: Useful for product reassurance, insurance/protection concepts, travel, lifestyle, and service explainers.
